issue.title: Bug: `_lldp_exists` timeout in `test_iface_namingmode.py` causes failures as it's too short in some cases

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

`iface_namingmode/test_iface_namingmode.py::TestConfigInterface::test_config_interface_state` fails sometimes due to `_lldp_exists` is not true within 30 seconds, we see in certain cases, it takes up to 60s for `_lldp_exists` to be true

```
17/06/2025 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0161 DEBUG  | _lldp_exists is False, wait 2 seconds and check again
17/06/2025 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0143 DEBUG  | Time elapsed: 53.319673 seconds
```

### Steps to Reproduce

On certain devices or topologies, it takes more than 30s to LLDP to reinstantiate after port toggle, toggle port and time lldp neighbor coming up or run `iface_namingmode/test_iface_namingmode.py::TestConfigInterface::test_config_interface_state`

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Test fails because `_lldp_exists` doesn't come up within 30s, it should pass if it comes up (so increase timeout)

### Relevant log output

```shell
17/06/2025 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0161 DEBUG  | _lldp_exists is False, wait 2 seconds and check again
17/06/2025 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0143 DEBUG  | Time elapsed: 53.319673 seconds
```

```shell

```

_No response_

Test is failing in certain scenarios where the timeout was too short, increase timeout so it passes
#### How did you do it?
Add a new constant `ESTABLISH_LLDP_NEIGHBOR_TIMEOUT`, and use that as the timout for `_lldp_exists` function
